ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

a. promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative efforts for basic health services; and

(3) Exemption from the burden of costs for Children as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b applies to Children from poor families unless regulated differently in accordance with the health financing program established by the government.

ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1
In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Regency is the Regency of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs which are the authority of the regency region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.
10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur or has occurred.
11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
13. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/endeavor and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.
16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional area to their area of origin.
18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT which organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of human trafficking.

Article 2
The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children is carried out based on the principles of:
a. respect and protection of human rights;
b. justice and gender equality;
c. non-discrimination;
d. best interests of the Child;
e. right to life, survival, and development;
f. Empowerment; and
g. legal certainty.

Article 3
Protection of Women and Children aims to:
a. guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of Women and Children;
b. maintain the integrity of the household so that a harmonious family is realized;
c. prevent violence against Women and Children;
d. protect and provide a sense of security for Women and Children;
e. provide services to Women and Children victims of acts of violence;
f. provide protection to reporters and witnesses; and
g. carry out empowerment of Women victims of violence.

CHAPTER IX

Article 32 Every person who intentionally commits or allows the occurrence of violence against women and children and/or does not report the occurrence of violence against women and children shall be subject to sanctions in accordance with the provisions stipulated in Law Number 35 of 2014 concerning Amendments to Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection and Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence.

ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1
In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Regency is the Regency of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs which are the authority of the regency region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.
10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur or has occurred.
11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
13. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/endeavor and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.
16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional area to their area of origin.
18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT which organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of human trafficking.

Article 2
The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children is carried out based on the principles of:
a. respect and protection of human rights;
b. justice and gender equality;
c. non-discrimination;
d. best interests of the Child;
e. right to life, survival, and development;
f. Empowerment; and
g. legal certainty.

Article 3
Protection of Women and Children aims to:
a. guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of Women and Children;
b. maintain the integrity of the household so that a harmonious family is realized;
c. prevent violence against Women and Children;
d. protect and provide a sense of security for Women and Children;
e. provide services to Women and Children victims of acts of violence;
f. provide protection to reporters and witnesses; and
g. carry out empowerment of Women victims of violence.

ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1
In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Regency is the Regency of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs which are the authority of the regency region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.
10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur or has occurred.
11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
13. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/endeavor and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.
16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional area to their area of origin.
18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT which organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of human trafficking.

Article 2
The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children is carried out based on the principles of:
a. respect and protection of human rights;
b. justice and gender equality;
c. non-discrimination;
d. best interests of the Child;
e. right to life, survival, and development;
f. Empowerment; and
g. legal certainty.

Article 3
Protection of Women and Children aims to:
a. guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of Women and Children;
b. maintain the integrity of the household so that a harmonious family is realized;
c. prevent violence against Women and Children;
d. protect and provide a sense of security for Women and Children;
e. provide services to Women and Children victims of acts of violence;
f. provide protection to reporters and witnesses; and
g. carry out empowerment of Women victims of violence.

ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1
In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Regency is the Regency of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs which are the authority of the regency region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.
10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur or has occurred.
11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
13. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/endeavor and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.
16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional area to their area of origin.
18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT which organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of human trafficking.

Article 2
The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children is carried out based on the principles of:
a. respect and protection of human rights;
b. justice and gender equality;
c. non-discrimination;
d. best interests of the Child;
e. right to life, survival, and development;
f. Empowerment; and
g. legal certainty.

Article 3
Protection of Women and Children aims to:
a. guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of Women and Children;
b. maintain the integrity of the household so that a harmonious family is realized;
c. prevent violence against Women and Children;
d. protect and provide a sense of security for Women and Children;
e. provide services to Women and Children victims of acts of violence;
f. provide protection to reporters and witnesses; and
g. carry out empowerment of Women victims of violence.

Point a
What is meant by "physical violence" is an act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and/or causes death. Point b
What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering to a person. Point c
What is meant by "sexual violence" is an act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced unnatural or unwanted sexual intercourse and/or forced sexual intercourse with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes. Point d
What is meant by "neglect" is an act that results in the failure to meet the needs of a child properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social, committed by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care; the act of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or look after a child as appropriate, committed by parents, guardians, or other parties responsible for their care; the act of neglecting a person within the scope of their household, whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obliged to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person; and/or an act that results in economic dependence by limiting and/or prohibiting proper work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person. Point e
What is meant by "exploitation" is an act that exploits economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others; an act with or without the victim's consent including prostitution, forced labor or service, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, utilization of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully transferring or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or utilizing the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain material or immaterial benefits; and/or any form of utilization of sexual organs or other body organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or indecency. Point f
What is meant by "other violence" is the threat of violence including: any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom; and coercion, including: a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will. Point f
What is meant by "social reintegration services" is aimed at returning victims to their families and social environment.

ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1
In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Regency is the Regency of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs which are the authority of the regency region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.
10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur or has occurred.
11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
13. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/endeavor and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.
16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional area to their area of origin.
18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT which organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of human trafficking.

Article 2
The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children is carried out based on the principles of:
a. respect and protection of human rights;
b. justice and gender equality;
c. non-discrimination;
d. best interests of the Child;
e. right to life, survival, and development;
f. Empowerment; and
g. legal certainty.

Article 3
Protection of Women and Children aims to:
a. guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of Women and Children;
b. maintain the integrity of the household so that a harmonious family is realized;
c. prevent violence against Women and Children;
d. protect and provide a sense of security for Women and Children;
e. provide services to Women and Children victims of acts of violence;
f. provide protection to reporters and witnesses; and
g. carry out empowerment of Women victims of violence.

CHAPTER IX
CRIMINAL PROVISIONS
Article 32 Every person who intentionally commits or allows the occurrence of violence against women and children and/or does not report the occurrence of violence against women and children shall be subject to sanctions in accordance with the provisions stipulated in Law Number 35 of 2014 concerning Amendments to Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection and Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence.

ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1
In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Regency is the Regency of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.

5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.
10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur or has occurred.
11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
13. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will occur, is occurring or has occurred.

ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

Article 1

c. non-discrimination;

I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1
In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Regency is the Regency of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs which are the authority of the regency region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.
10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur or has occurred.
11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
13. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/endeavor and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.
16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional area to their area of origin.
18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT which organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of human trafficking.

Article 2
The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children is carried out based on the principles of:
a. respect and protection of human rights;
b. justice and gender equality;
c. non-discrimination;
d. best interests of the Child;
e. right to life, survival, and development;
f. Empowerment; and
g. legal certainty.

Article 3
Protection of Women and Children aims to:
a. guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of Women and Children;
b. maintain the integrity of the household so that a harmonious family is realized;
c. prevent violence against Women and Children;
d. protect and provide a sense of security for Women and Children;
e. provide services to Women and Children victims of acts of violence;
f. provide protection to reporters and witnesses; and
g. carry out empowerment of Women victims of violence.

ABOUT
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Violence against women and children constitutes a violation of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. The fate of women and children victims of violence must be given attention by the regional government. The high number of cases of violence against women and children is often caused by factors that develop in society, for example low economic levels, education, environments located in the industrial sector. Therefore, victims of violence such as this need to receive protection in accordance with the principles of justice, truth, legal certainty, equality and upholding human rights.
For the empowerment of victims of violence, the district government establishes an Integrated Service Center (PPT) which is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as the Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment (P2TP2A), Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW), Shelters, etc.
The District Government is obligated and responsible to implement protection efforts for women and children through implementing protection policies for women and children applied by the government, establishing policies, programs, and protection activities for women and children, establishing PPT, guaranteeing the implementation of ease of services for victims, pursuing effectiveness and efficiency for the victim recovery process, and pursuing the creation of cooperation and coordination in efforts to protect women and children.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1
In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Regency is the Regency of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
2. Regency Government is the Regent as an element of regency government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir.
4. Regency Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and the Regency Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs which are the authority of the regency region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
6. Woman is a human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Fulfillment of Children's Rights is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
8. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological, and/or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of a person's freedom.
9. Victim is a woman and/or child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir Regency.
10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur or has occurred.
11. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
12. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
13. Service is action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
14. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to undertake business/endeavor and work independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
15. Health Rehabilitation is an effort to restore the condition of victims including physical, psychological and social health so that victims can carry out their roles again properly and reasonably both in the family and in society.
16. Social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
17. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the regional area to their area of origin.
18. Social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.
19. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is a unit that organizes integrated services for victims of violence and is integrated with PPT which organizes integrated services for witnesses and/or victims of criminal acts of human trafficking.

Article 2
The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children is carried out based on the principles of:
a. respect and protection of human rights;
b. justice and gender equality;
c. non-discrimination;
d. best interests of the Child;
e. right to life, survival, and development;
f. Empowerment; and
g. legal certainty.

Article 3
Protection of Women and Children aims to:
a. guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of Women and Children;
b. maintain the integrity of the household so that a harmonious family is realized;
c. prevent violence against Women and Children;
d. protect and provide a sense of security for Women and Children;
e. provide services to Women and Children victims of acts of violence;
f. provide protection to reporters and witnesses; and
g. carry out empowerment of Women victims of violence.

Financing

CHAPTER V
MONITORING AND EVALUATION
Article 27
(1) The Regency Government conducts monitoring to ensure synergy, balance and effectiveness of integrated measures in the implementation of policies, programs, activities, Protection of Women and Children.
(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by Regional Apparatus and PPT.
(3) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs and activities of Protection of Women and Children.
(4) Monitoring is conducted periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of Regional Apparatus implementing policies, activities of Protection of Women and Children.
(5) Monitoring stages as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
a. planning
b. policy implementation;
c. program implementation; and
d. Protection of Women and Children activities every year.
Article 28
(1) Evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs and activities of Protection of Women and Children is conducted at the end of each Fiscal Year or if necessary according to needs.
(2) The results of evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs and activities of Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1) are used as input material for the formulation of policies, programs and activities for the following year.
(3) Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
